construction: One fixed nilpotent shear per MLP. Select v in Null([W0,b0]^T) using native/path preactivation and activation moments; then select u in Null([V0;v^T]) using the exact first-order nonlinear output Schur Gram. Unit u/v, fixed amplitude 1, no optimizer, defender gradients, response fitting, sweep or future partner.
public_attack: Wr=W0+PV(Wp-W0), br=b0+PV(bp-b0), Vr=V0+(Vp-V0)PW. PV projects onto rowspace(V0); PW onto colspace([W0,b0]). Test the same attack on original and protected experts; do not assume floating-point state identity or ignore deletion cost.
data: Reuse verified 64 DTD training calibration inputs and 24 disjoint training confirmation images. They were inspected in previous research. Layer selection comes from prior supervised task_profile. Neither ground truth nor public classifier head enters direction selection. Head prediction changes are a post-freeze screen only; no official test or real fusion partner is read.
screen: Save protection weights first. Verify exact nonlinear low-rank/direct formulas, first-order Schur energy, analytical Taylor remainder bound, and public deletion. Save normalized feature and target-head prediction changes on native and target-only beta paths. Screen results are not accuracy or defense results; no parameter adjustment on their outcome.
claims: This is an approximate nonlinear reparameterization, not an exact GELU symmetry or irreversible protection. Neither shear transformations nor generalized eigenproblems are claimed as novel. Requires matched standalone, real fusion, author AGA, public cross-span deletion, whole MLP reset and finite-query recovery before any efficacy claim.
